title: Techdim Debian 13 Hardening Framework & Ephemeral KVM Sandbox (Kether_1)
description: Reproducible Zero Trust and CIS Benchmark Level 2 hardening framework for Debian 13 (Trixie) hosts executing autonomous AI agents without breaking unprivileged user namespaces (userns) or eBPF. Includes deterministic hardening architecture, AppArmor confinement profiles, auditd telemetry, ephemeral QCOW2/KVM sandbox isolation, and an auditable metrics collector.
